title: Cloud & DevOps — App Service vs AKS, CI/CD
exp: At 4 YOE, compare hosting options and describe a safe deploy/rollback path.
pts: App Service: faster PaaS path, less ops.
CI/CD: build → test → image → deploy → health smoke → rollback.
Secrets via Key Vault / managed identity — not committed strings.
Multi-stage Docker builds for smaller .NET images.
pr: Write a GitHub Actions outline for build/test/deploy
List secrets that should move to Key Vault

qa.q: App Service vs AKS for a single .NET API?
qa.a: Default to App Service for one API needing speed-to-prod and managed scaling. Choose AKS when you run many services, need custom networking/sidecars, or already operate Kubernetes. Don't adopt K8s for resume points alone.
